children: New live music offerings, enhanced performance venue and heritage-inspired design come together as part of Holland America Evolution
Key Highlights
New Ocean Bar debuts aboard Oosterdam as part of Holland America Evolution. New stage expands entertainment offerings, including Vivace Strings, soloists, pianists and late-night cabaret.
Relocated bar and redesigned layout bring guests closer to live performances while creating a more connected venue.
Design inspired by travel's golden age features Art Deco influences, custom furnishings and refreshed materials that blend craftsmanship with sustainability.

SEATTLE, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Holland America Line Evolution is bringing a new chapter to Ocean Bar aboard Oosterdam. Inspired by the glamour of the golden age of ocean travel, the redesigned venue brings live entertainment, cocktails and conversation together in a sophisticated new setting, featuring a new stage, refreshed lounge spaces and a reimagined layout designed to connect guests more closely with the performances.

The transformation introduces a new stage designed to showcase a wider range of programming, from regional soloists and pianists to Vivace Strings performances and late-night cabaret. A redesigned bar, strategically relocated to create a stronger connection to the performances, refreshed seating and inviting lounge spaces create an atmosphere equally suited for a signature cocktail, an evening performance or conversation long after the music ends.

"With the new Ocean Bar, we wanted to draw on the qualities that have made travel by sea so enduring, from its sense of elegance and occasion to the connections created along the way," said Michael Stendebach, senior vice president of food, beverage and rooms division for Holland America Line. "Inspired by our maritime heritage, including design details drawn from Rotterdam V, this reimagined venue creates a setting where guests can gather for a cocktail, enjoy live music and immerse themselves in the refined elegance that has always been part of the Holland America experience."

Bringing that vision to life, the refreshed Ocean Bar pairs refined aesthetics with enhancements designed to strengthen the connection between guests, the entertainment and the surrounding space. The redesigned bar serves as a focal point for the venue, with refreshed furnishings upholstered in fabrics made from recycled materials reflecting a purposeful balance of craftsmanship, innovation and sustainability.
Where Classic Cruising Inspires Modern Design

The redesigned Ocean Bar blends Art Deco elegance with subtle nautical influences to create a setting that feels both warm and sophisticated. Custom furnishings developed specifically for the venue feature details inspired by vintage travel trunks and luggage, including leather accents that nod to the romance of classic cruising.

The redesign also reflects Holland America Line's commitment to responsible stewardship. Existing lounge furnishings with years of life remaining will be refreshed and reupholstered in fabrics made with recycled content, giving well-loved pieces a new chapter while creating a balance between preservation and renewal. Combined with redesigned seating areas and a more open layout, the result is a venue that feels both familiar and new.
Bringing the Pinnacle Experience to More Ships

As the largest fleet update in the company's 153-year history, Holland America Evolution will revitalize all six Vista Class and Signature Class ships, starting with Oosterdam and Zuiderdam. The enhancements blend new offerings with guest favorites inspired by Holland America Line's Pinnacle Class ships. Designed around guest feedback, Evolution combines refreshed public areas, expanded venues and enhanced onboard offerings with the gracious service, destination-rich travel and perfectly sized ships that define Holland America Line. The company will invest more than $500 million across the six ships, including enhancements to onboard amenities and additional staterooms and suites that will provide more choice for travelers.

About Holland America Line

Holland America Line has been exploring the world for more than 150 years with expertly crafted itineraries, extraordinary service and genuine connections to the destinations. Offering a perfectly-sized ship experience, its fleet of 11 vessels visits nearly 400 ports in 114 countries around the world and has shared the thrill of Alaska for more than 75 years — longer than any other cruise line. Savour the Journey isn't just a tagline, it's a reinforcement that the cruise line provides experiences too good to hurry through, connecting travelers to the world and each other. Award-winning enrichment programming, entertainment and cuisine that brings each locale on board, including a revolutionary Global Fresh Fish Program, put Holland America Line at the forefront of premium cruising. Holland America Line is part of Carnival Corporation, the world's largest cruise company with a portfolio of cruise lines operating in over 800 ports & destinations worldwide.
